summary: Retested EduSync Phase 1 on the public preview. All three requested fixes pass: principal Add Students moves students and refreshes roster/count, teachers can view non-taught rosters with full privacy redaction, and teacher student detail is redacted. All listed regressions pass through API and UI. One assignment data-integrity edge case remains: the principal API accepts a nonexistent target batch and mutates the student's batch_id.

critical.issue: The endpoint never validates that {bid} exists and belongs to the principal's institute. Assigning a real student to a random UUID returns 200 with moved:1 and persists that invalid batch_id, removing the student from valid class rosters until repaired. The test restores the student in teardown.

action_items: Before update_many in POST /batches/{bid}/assign, require an institute-scoped batch lookup and return 404 when the target class does not exist; use a Pydantic request model for student_ids.
critical_code_review_comments: assign_students accepts an unvalidated raw dict and updates students without first resolving {bid} under the current institute; this creates dangling or cross-institute batch references even though the happy-path UI works.
server.py is 4,376 lines, far above the 700-line maintainability threshold; class/student/homework routes should be split into focused modules.

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10 targeted API tests passed; every requested happy-path fix/regression passed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (principal assignment, class create/edit, teacher cross-class roster, and cross-class homework flows passed)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable API classes/homework and one UI class/homework. The UI assignment temporarily moved one existing student. All classes/homework were deleted and all student batch assignments were restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview is healthy. Principal UI Add Students changed Class 8-A count 6→7 and refreshed the roster, then cleanup restored the selected student. Anita sees all 4 classes; Class 9-A was the current populated i_teach=false class and its 14-student roster returned 200 with no hidden fields. Teacher UI homework creation for Class 9-A passed. Current seed data marks Class 8-A teacher_id as Anita, contrary to the request note saying it is not her class; use a current i_teach=false class for non-taught regression. No Batches/Homework console errors were observed.
rca_of_the_issue: assign_students directly executes update_many using the path bid and same-institute student IDs. There is no db.batches.find_one({id: bid, institute_id: current institute}) guard, so arbitrary target IDs are persisted. Reproduction: mint a principal token, POST /api/batches/<random-uuid>/assign with one valid same-institute student ID; response is 200 {ok:true,moved:1}, and the student's batch_id becomes the random UUID.
